column1: # The repositories this estate deploys from, for supply-check (and the fork sync to come).
# kind: go | python | frappe | js | ansible = a fork (merge-synced with its upstream; GitHub runs no
#       Dependabot alerts on forks), own = ours and running on the pipeline box, own-aux = ours, tooling
#       or documents (alerts reported, never CRIT). pin = <role>:<variable> in roles/<role>/defaults
#       naming the release the roles install, or -.
# sync: branch = merge the upstream branch head; tag = merge the newest upstream tag (the forks whose release
#       tags shadow upstream's); - for our own repositories.
